# `returning-local-slice`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a returned slice that points into a local array.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

The array's storage expires at function return, leaving the caller with a
dangling slice.

## When it fires

It applies when the returned slice and local backing array can be connected by
binding identity.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn name() []const u8 {
    var buf: [16]u8 = undefined;
    buf[0] = 'a';
    return buf[0..1];
}
```
